decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be of a conservation style and installed flush with the plane of the roof.

Condition : 7 - The erection of a single storey rear extension and a rear dormer roof extension to the existing house, as shown on drawing number 60309/02 A received 16 August 2006 (Amended plan), is satisfactory as the development would not unduly alter the appearance of the house and would maintain the amenity of adjoining neighbours, and is considered to preserve the character and appearance of the Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension with roof windows to front elevation of house
